def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain nonpositive log probabilities")
    # Same shape
    s = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != s or logp_no_call.shape != s:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter: not bool, must be finite nonnegative
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = s

    # Compute normalized future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=np.float64)  # offset from first future token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute weighted losses (T02)
    # L = - sum_i weight_i * log_prob_i (log_prob already negative, so L positive)
    L_plus = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
